SZ20 On-Load Oil-Immersed Transformer

The SZ20 series combines an on-load tap changer with a 6–11 kV / 0.4 kV distribution transformer. The published table covers 200–2,500 kVA and identifies losses, no-load current and short-circuit impedance by capacity.

Engineering considerations

Design and selection

On-load voltage regulation

The tap changer adjusts the high-voltage winding ratio without interrupting the connected load. Specify the required regulation range, control method and network voltage profile.

Loss and impedance coordination

The catalog publishes separate loss and impedance values for each rated capacity. Check these against the project efficiency target, available fault level and protection settings.

Controls and accessories

The source describes an optional intelligent control arrangement. Define monitoring, alarms, communications and accessory requirements in the approved project schedule.

Applications

Where it is specified

  • Distribution feeders with changing supply voltage
  • Industrial and mining distribution systems
  • Replacement projects requiring on-load regulation

Information for model selection

  • Capacity and HV/LV voltage
  • Tap range and automatic voltage control requirements
  • Loss, impedance and accessory requirements
